title: Generate Wrapped from landing page and load results
description: Entering a valid GitHub username on the landing page navigates to the user Wrapped page and shows the Wrapped preview content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with octocat
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Verify the user lands on a user Wrapped results page
Verify a Wrapped preview with metric cards is displayed

title: Invalid username shows error UI on results page
description: Submitting a clearly invalid GitHub username navigates to the results route and displays an error state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with this-user-should-not-exist-1234567890
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Verify the user lands on a user Wrapped results page
Verify an error state is displayed indicating the Wrapped could not be generated

title: Username input trims surrounding whitespace
description: Submitting a username with leading/trailing spaces still navigates to the intended Wrapped page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with  octocat
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Verify the user lands on a user Wrapped results page
Verify a Wrapped preview with metric cards is displayed

title: Empty username submission is blocked with validation feedback

steps.description: Navigate to /
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Verify the user remains on the landing page
Verify a username validation error is visible

title: Username accepts uppercase characters and still loads results
description: Submitting a valid username in mixed/uppercase proceeds and loads the Wrapped page.

Fill in the GitHub username field with OCTOCAT
Submit the form to generate Wrapped

Verify a Wrapped preview with metric cards is displayed

title: Landing page primary content loads
description: The landing page loads and provides the primary action to enter a username and generate Wrapped.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the username input field is displayed
Verify the generate Wrapped action is available

title: Wrapped page loads profile summary and computed metric cards for a known user
description: Opening a user Wrapped page renders the profile summary and populated metric cards.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with octocat
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Verify a profile summary section is displayed
Verify metric cards are populated with computed stats

title: Wrapped page shows invalid username error state

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with this-user-should-not-exist-1234567890
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Verify an error state is displayed indicating the username is invalid or could not be found

title: Wrapped page renders multiple distinct metric cards
description: The Wrapped page displays multiple metric cards as part of the computed results.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with octocat
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Click the carousel next control
Verify metric cards are displayed and change when navigating through the carousel

title: Refreshless initial load shows results without requiring user interaction
description: After generating Wrapped, the results are visible without any additional clicks.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with octocat
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Verify the Wrapped preview content is displayed without additional user actions

title: Wrapped page remains usable while content is loading
description: The page provides a deterministic loading or placeholder state before computed data is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with octocat
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Wait for the Wrapped page content to finish loading
Verify the final profile summary and metric cards are displayed

title: Advance carousel with right arrow key
description: Using the keyboard right arrow advances the carousel to the next card.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with octocat
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Press ArrowRight
Verify the carousel advances to a different metric card

title: Navigate carousel with previous and next controls
description: Clicking the next and previous controls changes the visible metric card.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with octocat
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Click the carousel next control
Click the carousel previous control
Verify the carousel changes cards when using the navigation controls

title: Jump to a specific card via progress dots
description: Selecting a progress dot navigates directly to the corresponding card.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with octocat
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Click a non-active carousel progress dot
Verify the carousel jumps to the selected metric card

title: Reverse carousel with left arrow key
description: Using the keyboard left arrow moves the carousel back to the previous card.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with octocat
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Press ArrowRight
Press ArrowLeft
Verify the carousel returns to the earlier metric card

title: Carousel remains functional after rapid sequential navigation
description: Rapidly navigating through cards does not break the carousel and continues to show metric cards.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the GitHub username field with octocat
Submit the form to generate Wrapped
Click the carousel next control
Click the carousel next control
Click a carousel progress dot
Verify a metric card is displayed after rapid navigation

title: Export current metric card as PNG
description: Verifies a user can export the currently focused metric card as a PNG image from the Wrapped results page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill a valid public GitHub username into the username field
Submit the username to generate the Wrapped
Focus the desired metric card in the carousel
Click the action to export the current card as a PNG image
Verify a PNG image download is initiated

Submit the username to generate the Wrapped
